quests.hint: A common pet that meows and catches mice.
quests.explanation: 'Cat' is a popular domestic animal kept as a pet. Cats are known for being independent and affectionate.
quests.definition: A small furry domestic animal kept as a pet.
quests.example: Our cat sleeps on the sofa for most of the day.

quests.hint: A loyal pet that barks and loves walks.
quests.explanation: 'Dog' is the most popular domestic pet. Dogs are loyal, friendly animals that people keep as companions.
quests.definition: A domestic animal kept as a pet, known for loyalty and friendliness.
quests.example: He takes his dog for a long walk in the park every morning.

quests.hint: People use this to travel on roads - it has four wheels.
quests.explanation: 'Car' is a vehicle with four wheels and an engine used for personal transport on roads.
quests.definition: A four-wheeled vehicle with an engine used for road transport.
quests.example: She drives her car to work every day because the bus is too slow.

quests.hint: A large vehicle that carries many passengers along a fixed route.
quests.explanation: 'Bus' is a large public vehicle that carries passengers along a fixed route. Many people use buses to commute.
quests.definition: A large public vehicle that carries many passengers along a fixed route.
quests.example: I take the bus to school every morning because it is cheap.

quests.hint: Pages bound together that you read - fiction or non-fiction.
quests.explanation: 'Book' is a collection of printed pages bound together. Books are fundamental to education and entertainment.
quests.definition: A set of printed pages bound together for reading.
quests.example: I borrowed a book about photography from the library last week.

quests.hint: You use this device to call people or browse the internet.
quests.explanation: 'Phone' is a device used to make calls and send messages. Modern smartphones can also browse the internet.
quests.definition: A device used to make calls, send messages, and access the internet.
quests.example: Can I borrow your phone? My battery is completely dead.

quests.hint: Coins and notes you use to buy things.
quests.explanation: 'Money' is the coins and notes used to buy goods and services. Managing money well is an important life skill.
quests.definition: Coins and notes used to buy goods and services.
quests.example: I need to save more money if I want to go on holiday this year.

quests.hint: This tells you what hour it is - you can check it on a clock or phone.
quests.explanation: 'Time' refers to the ongoing sequence of events. We measure it in seconds, minutes, hours, days, and years.
quests.definition: The ongoing sequence of events measured in hours, minutes, and seconds.
quests.example: What time does the next train to London arrive?

quests.hint: You go here to buy food, clothes, or other products.
quests.explanation: 'Shop' is a place where goods are sold. In British English we say 'shop'; in American English, 'store'.
quests.definition: A place where goods are sold to customers.
quests.example: There is a small bakery shop near my house that sells wonderful bread.

quests.hint: A road or path in a town or city with buildings on both sides.
quests.explanation: 'Street' is a public road in a town or city with buildings on one or both sides. It often has a name.
quests.definition: A public road in a town or city with buildings alongside.
quests.example: She lives on a quiet street just around the corner from the park.

quests.hint: A large urban area with many buildings, businesses, and people.
quests.explanation: 'City' is a large urban area. Cities are centres of business, culture, and government.
quests.definition: A large urban area with many people, buildings, and services.
quests.example: London is one of the most exciting cities in the world to visit.

quests.hint: A space inside a building used for a specific purpose - bedroom, kitchen etc.
quests.explanation: 'Room' is an area within a building separated by walls. A house or apartment has several rooms.
quests.definition: A space within a building enclosed by walls, floor, and ceiling.
quests.example: The hotel room was clean, comfortable, and had a beautiful sea view.

quests.hint: A flat piece of furniture where people sit to eat or work.
quests.explanation: 'Table' is a piece of furniture with a flat top and legs. People use tables for eating, working, and studying.
quests.definition: A piece of furniture with a flat surface and legs used for eating or working.
quests.example: Please set the table for dinner. Dinner will be ready in ten minutes.

quests.hint: You sit on this piece of furniture - it has four legs and a back.
quests.explanation: 'Chair' is a seat with a back support for one person. We sit on chairs at tables and desks.
quests.definition: A separate seat with a back support designed for one person.
quests.example: Please pull up a chair and sit down — this meeting will take a while.

quests.hint: You sleep in this piece of furniture at night.
quests.explanation: 'Bed' is a piece of furniture you sleep on. Getting a good night's sleep in a comfortable bed is important for health.
quests.definition: A piece of furniture used for sleeping and resting.
quests.example: I was so tired after work that I went straight to bed at eight o'clock.

quests.hint: The room in a home where food is prepared and cooked.
quests.explanation: 'Kitchen' is the room where food is prepared and cooked. It usually contains a cooker, refrigerator, and sink.
quests.definition: The room in a home where food is prepared and cooked.
quests.example: The kitchen smelled wonderful because she was baking chocolate cake.

quests.hint: An outdoor area with grass and plants behind a house.
quests.explanation: 'Garden' is an area of land near a house with plants, grass, and flowers. Gardens are places to relax outdoors.
quests.definition: An area of land near a home where plants, grass, and flowers grow.
quests.example: We had a lovely barbecue in the garden last Sunday afternoon.

quests.hint: A green outdoor area in a city where people walk, relax, and exercise.
quests.explanation: 'Park' is a public area with grass, trees, and paths where people relax and exercise. Cities have parks for recreation.
quests.definition: A public area with grass and trees where people relax and exercise.
quests.example: Let's take the children to the park this afternoon to play football.

quests.hint: Something you carry your belongings in - a backpack or handbag.
quests.explanation: 'Bag' is a container made of cloth, leather, or plastic used to carry things. We use bags for shopping and travel.
quests.definition: A container made of cloth or leather used for carrying things.
quests.example: Don't forget to pack your bag the night before your trip.

quests.hint: What you wear on your body every day - shirts, trousers, dresses.
quests.explanation: 'Clothes' are the garments people wear. Choosing the right clothes for the right occasion is important.
quests.definition: Garments and items worn to cover the body.
quests.example: She bought several new clothes for her holiday in the south of France.

quests.hint: You wear these on your feet - boots, trainers, heels.
quests.explanation: 'Shoes' are coverings worn on the feet for protection and comfort. There are many different styles for different occasions.
quests.definition: Coverings worn on the feet, made of leather or other materials.
quests.example: I need to buy new shoes for my brother's wedding next month.

quests.hint: The early part of the day - before noon, after waking up.
quests.explanation: 'Morning' is the part of the day from sunrise until noon. Many people are most productive in the morning.
quests.definition: The part of the day from sunrise to noon.
quests.example: I always feel more energetic in the morning than in the afternoon.

quests.hint: The middle part of the day - between 12:00 and 18:00.
quests.explanation: 'Afternoon' is the time between noon and evening. Many people have lunch at the start of the afternoon.
quests.definition: The part of the day from noon until evening.
quests.example: She has a yoga class every Tuesday and Thursday afternoon.

quests.hint: The part of the day after 18:00 when it starts getting dark.
quests.explanation: 'Evening' is the period from late afternoon to bedtime. Many families have dinner together in the evening.
quests.definition: The period of the day from late afternoon until bedtime.
quests.example: Would you like to join us for dinner this evening at seven o'clock?

quests.hint: The group of people you are related to - parents, siblings, grandparents.
quests.explanation: 'Family' refers to a group of people related by blood or marriage. Family is an important part of most cultures.
quests.definition: A group of people related by blood or marriage who live together or support each other.
quests.example: We always spend Christmas with our extended family at my grandmother's house.

quests.hint: The female parent - she raised you and cares for you.
quests.explanation: 'Mother' is a female parent. Mothers play a central role in families across all cultures.
quests.definition: A female parent who gives birth to and raises a child.
quests.example: My mother taught me how to cook traditional recipes when I was young.

quests.hint: The male parent - he raised you and is part of your family.
quests.explanation: 'Father' is a male parent. Fathers provide guidance, support, and love to their children.
quests.definition: A male parent who helps raise and care for a child.
quests.example: My father works as an engineer and has always inspired me to study hard.

quests.hint: A female sibling who shares at least one parent with you.
quests.explanation: 'Sister' is a girl or woman who shares the same parents as you. Sisters are siblings.
quests.definition: A girl or woman who has the same parents as you.
quests.example: My younger sister just started studying medicine at university this year.

quests.hint: A male sibling who shares at least one parent with you.
quests.explanation: 'Brother' is a boy or man who shares the same parents as you. Brothers and sisters are siblings.
quests.definition: A boy or man who has the same parents as you.
quests.example: My older brother is getting married next spring and I am the best man.

quests.hint: A person who teaches you at school or college.
quests.explanation: 'Teacher' is a person whose job is to teach students in a school or college. Good teachers inspire lifelong learning.
quests.definition: A person whose job is to teach knowledge and skills to students.
quests.example: My English teacher always made the lessons interesting and enjoyable.
